clues.text: Standing 130 feet tall, this high-energy ride reaches a top speed of 58 mph and flips riders upside down through 3 inversions.
Manufactured by RMC, this coaster officially opened to park guests in 2021.
This coaster operates at an amusement park located in Jackson, New Jersey.
It made headlines as RMC's first custom Raptor Track layout and debuted as the world's tallest, fastest, and longest single-rail roller coaster.
This coaster shares its name with the legendary winged, demonic cryptid said to haunt the local region.

evidence.quote: '''Jersey Devil Coaster''' is a [[steel]] [[single rail roller coaster|single rail]] [[roller coaster]] at [[Six Flags Great Adventure]] in Jackson, New Jersey, USA.
It is the first custom-made RMC [[Raptor Track]], as well as the world's tallest, fastest, and longest single-rail roller coaster.
